DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency).

The combination of ambiguous genitalia at birth (labial fusion, clitoromegaly), delayed menarche, virilization in the mother, and bone fragility is highly suggestive of a specific enzymatic defect. REQUEST TEST: 17-hydroxyprogesterone level. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_ultrasound.
